sahneler.metin: A brand-new British submarine sank during its first dive.
Within hours, ninety nine men were dead.
A torpedo tube was opened from inside.
Its outer door was already open to the sea.
A small test hole should have shown water in the tube.
It had been blocked by paint.
The sea flooded the bow, and only four men escaped.
Torpedo tube interlocks and tests were changed.

aciklama:
HMS Thetis sank during her diving trials. The cause: a test cock blocked by paint, hiding that the outer bow cap was open.
